consigne_scene: Three-quarter view of a private home study desk at night, seen slightly from above: on the right side, a neat stack of plain buff kraft card folders with blank index tabs, one folder lying half open and completely empty, an old brass desk lamp casting a warm pool of light on them, the whole left half of the frame a calm dark wooden desktop falling into deep shadow, a modest private desk and nothing like an office or a police room

emplacement: fond de la série Alien Transcripts
consigne_scene: Side view of a vintage reel-to-reel tape recorder standing on a dark wooden table in a small quiet room at night, placed in the right half of the frame, the whole machine in crisp sharp focus with fine detail on the two tape reels and the brushed steel, lit by one warm lamp, a few blank sheets of paper stacked beside it, the left half and the upper part of the frame a plain dark wall in shadow with nothing on it, no picture, no window, no shape in the background, nobody in the room

alt: Dolmen sur une colline rocheuse au crépuscule
consigne_scene: A single ancient dolmen alone on a rocky moss-covered hilltop at dusk, seen from a low angle: one huge flat capstone resting on four rough upright stones, placed in the right half of the frame, the whole left half open sky with soft orange and pink dusk clouds above distant dark hills, the very first stars, the same monument as a lone megalithic tomb and nothing else, not Stonehenge, no stone circle, no row of standing stones, no second monument, nobody in the frame

consigne_scene: Close view from above into one open drawer of an old dark steel filing cabinet in a private study, the drawer tightly filled with hanging buff kraft card folders receding into soft focus, every index tab blank cream card with nothing written, one folder pulled up slightly higher than the others, warm lamp light from one side, the top third of the frame dark and calm

alt: Ciel étoilé au-dessus de collines sombres, lueur à l'horizon
consigne_scene: Real long-exposure night photograph of a vast clear sky dense with sharp pinpoint stars and a soft natural band of the Milky Way rising from the right, above a low line of dark rolling hills, a thin warm glow along the horizon, the whole left half of the frame open dark sky, a true astrophotograph with fine natural grain and not an illustration, no flat vector shapes, nobody in the frame, the sky completely natural with no craft, no beam and no strange light

alt: Tiroir de classeur avec une chemise manquante
consigne_scene: Real photograph looking straight into one open drawer of an old dark steel filing cabinet: a tight row of worn buff kraft card folders standing upright with blank tabs, softly out of focus at both ends, and one clear empty gap in the middle where a single folder is missing, a thin shaft of warm lamp light falling exactly into the gap, real paper texture with worn edges and dust, the upper part of the frame dark and calm, a true photograph and not an illustration, not flat vector art, no glass case, no display box, no frame around the drawer
